extensionDescription.message: Search with the locally installed Buzzard Search service.

searchIntro.message: Results come from the locally installed Buzzard Search command.

noResults.message: No results found. Try changing the query or provider.

errorUnsupportedBrowser.message: This extension requires WildBuzzard's built-in search bridge.

errorMissingCli.message: Buzzard Search is not installed. Run sudo apt install buzzard-search, then try again.

errorBusy.message: Two searches are already running. Wait for one to finish.

errorProtocolMismatch.message: The installed Buzzard Search package uses an incompatible protocol version.

errorTimeout.message: The search took too long. Try again or use a smaller result count.

errorInvalidRequest.message: The search options were rejected. Review the extension settings.

errorInvalidOutput.message: The local search service returned an unsupported response.

errorOutputTooLarge.message: The local search response exceeded the browser safety limit.

errorCliFailed.message: The local search service failed. Try another provider.

errorSearxngNotConfigured.message: Configure a SearXNG server URL in the extension settings before using this provider.

optionsDescription.message: Choose defaults for the extension. The browser passes searches to /usr/bin/buzzard-search without a shell.

searxngUrlHelp.message: Required when SearXNG is the default provider. Use HTTPS, or HTTP only for a loopback address.

invalidEndpoint.message: Enter an HTTPS URL, or an HTTP loopback URL without credentials.

invalidEngines.message: Enter at most 10 unique engine names using letters, numbers, spaces, periods, underscores, or hyphens.

cliUnavailable.message: The buzzard-search package was not found. Run sudo apt install buzzard-search, then try again.
